title: 第5章 引狼入室第6章 报复回来了
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
“嗡！”
李大炮感觉到，自己脑海中的功德葫芦又有了动静，随后又多了一滴绿色的灵液。
“我这是做好事，得到了奖励吗？”
李大炮暗道，他好像有些明白了，等回家后再慢慢研究。
看着眼前的孟晚晴，肤白貌美大长腿，整个牛犊子村，估计只有叶秋玲能够和她一较高下。
她浑身都湿了，身上的白衬衣紧紧地贴在身上，都能看到粉色的内衣轮廓，以及白皙的肌肤。
咕噜！
李大炮艰难地咽了一口口水，他感觉有些口干舌燥，好像有流鼻血的冲动。
孟晚晴似乎感觉到李大炮的呼吸在变重，连忙双手抱胸，喝道：“你，你，你想对我做什么？”
李大炮有些汗颜，随后开口打趣：“我李大炮在牛犊子村也算是一个光棍，今天救了你也算是缘分，要不你就留在村里给我当媳妇，再给我生几个大胖小子。”
“啊？不要，你别冲动，我可以用别的方式报答你。”
孟晚晴花容失色，她感觉被之前的粉丝说中了，真有可能来到了一个土匪窝。
李大炮看到她脸都白了，不再吓她，立即改口：“跟你开玩笑的，不过你也不像是牛犊子村的人，怎么会出现在这里？”
“开玩笑的。”
孟晚晴松了一口气，她放下双手，接着支支吾吾的说道：“我，我，我是来这里担任村支书的。
“你来我们村担任村支书？”
李大炮非常惊讶，这么一个娇滴滴的大美女，跑到他们这山沟沟来当村支书，这是有多么想不开。
孟晚晴点点头，她看向李大炮，见他依然一副想开炮的样子，而且还瞄准了她，让她有些心慌意乱。
“抱歉，我们兄弟闹了点意见，有点不听我的话。”
李大炮尴尬的说道，随后转过身去，控制住学习的混沌阴阳仙经，这才恢复了正常。

孟晚晴红着脸，感觉被李大炮调戏了，但又觉得他是个好人，算半个正人君子。
不然这里前不着村后不着店的，他要是真想干点什么，还不得让他得逞了。
“你是牛犊子村的村民吗？”孟晚晴主动问道。
“对的，我是牛犊子村的村民，我叫李大炮，呸，我叫李风。”
李大炮觉得以后要给自己正名，大炮是村民给他起的外号，总不能以后一直顶着这个外号去混江湖。
李风这个名字听起来还比较正常。
要说他叫李大炮，每次介绍自己，都得尴尬的先用脚趾抠个3室1厅。
“李风。”
孟晚晴有些怀疑，似乎觉得这么偏僻的小村子，叫李大炮反而更应景。
“美女，你叫什么？为什么这么想不开，跑到这来当村支书？”李大炮问道。
“我叫孟晚晴，至于我为什么来这里当村支书，当然是为人民服务，来这里扶贫，带领大家一起脱贫致富。”
孟晚晴说道，实际上她是被逼无奈，准备证明一下自己的能力，省得被家族当成工具一样拿去联姻。
她和家族打了个赌，要是三年内能够带领牛犊子村脱贫致富，那就可以掌控自己的人生。
“扶贫啊，这个好，要不先给我扶个贫，我家里正差个婆娘。”叶大炮笑道。
“去你的，没正经，网络新闻看多了吧。”
孟晚晴啐道，想着这家伙壮得跟头驴一样，不愧是牛犊子村的村民，就是一只牛犊子。
“嘿嘿，我回村了，你回村吗？”李大炮问道。
“当然回村，你帮我把行李箱拿过来一下，我要换件衣服。”
孟晚晴说道，她指了指之前摔下去的地方，还好行李箱没有跟着一起掉进河里，不然只怕都找不到。
李大炮立即把她的行李箱拿了过来，现在天都黑了，外面没有人，不用担心被偷看。
content_en:
"Buzz!"
Li Dapao felt that the merit gourd in his mind moved again, and then there was another drop of green spiritual liquid.
"Did I do something good and get a reward?"
Li Dapao secretly thought that he seemed to understand somewhat and would study it slowly after returning home.
Looking at Meng Wanqing in front of her, she is fair-skinned, beautiful and has long legs. In the entire Niuduzi Village, it is estimated that only Ye Qiuling can compete with her.
She was wet all over, and the white shirt she wore clung tightly to her body, and she could see the outline of the pink underwear and her fair skin.
Gulu!
Li Dapao swallowed hard. He felt a little dry and had the urge to have a nosebleed.
Meng Wanqing seemed to feel that Li Dapao's breathing was getting heavier, and she quickly crossed her arms and shouted: "You, you, what do you want to do to me?"
Li Dapao was a little embarrassed, and then he joked: "I, Li Dapao, am considered a bachelor in Niuduzi Village. It is fate that I saved you today. Otherwise, you can stay in the village and be my wife, and give birth to some fat boys for me."
"Ah? No, don't be impulsive. I can repay you in other ways."
Meng Wanqing's beauty turned pale. She felt that her previous fans had told her that she might have arrived at a bandit's den.
When Li Dapao saw that her face turned pale, he stopped scaring her and immediately changed his words: "I'm kidding you, but you don't look like someone from Niuduzi Village, so why are you here?"
"Just kidding."
Meng Wanqing breathed a sigh of relief, put down her hands, and then said hesitantly: "I, I, I am here to serve as the village party secretary.
"You came to our village to serve as the village party secretary? "
Li Dapao was very surprised. It was so unimaginable that such a delicate beauty came to their mountain valley to become the village party secretary.
Meng Wanqing nodded. She looked at Li Dapao and saw that he still looked like he wanted to fire, and he was also aiming at her, which made her a little flustered.
"Sorry, our brothers had some disagreements and didn't listen to me. "
Li Dapao said awkwardly, then turned around, controlled the Chaos Yin Yang Immortal Sutra he was studying, and then returned to normal.
Meng Wanqing blushed, feeling that she had been teased by Li Dapao, but she also felt that he was a good person and a semi-gentleman.
Otherwise, this place is completely out of date, and if he really wants to do something, he must not be allowed to succeed.
"Are you a villager from Niuduzi Village? "Meng Wanqing asked proactively.
"Yes, I am a villager in Niuduzi Village, my name is Li Dapao, bah, my name is Li Feng. "
Li Dapao felt that he had to clear his name in the future. Dapao was a nickname given to him by the villagers, and he could not continue to use this nickname in the future.
The name Li Feng sounds relatively normal.
To say that his name is Li Dapao, every time he introduces himself, he has to dig his toes into the three bedrooms and one living room in embarrassment.
"Li Feng. "
Meng Wanqing was a little skeptical, as if calling such a remote village Li Dapao would be more appropriate.
"Beauty, what's your name? Why are you so reluctant to come here to be the village party secretary? Li Dapao asked.
"My name is Meng Wanqing. As for why I come here to be the village party secretary, of course I am to serve the people, to help the poor, and to lead everyone out of poverty and become rich. "
Meng Wanqing said that in fact she was forced to do so and was ready to prove her ability to avoid being used as a tool by her family for marriage.
She made a bet with her family that if she could lead Niudaozi Village out of poverty and become rich within three years, she would be able to control her own life.
"Poverty alleviation, this is good, why don't you help me a poor person first, I just need a wife in my family. "Ye Dapao said with a smile.
"Screw you, you are not serious, you have read too much online news. "
Meng Wanqing spat, thinking that this guy was as strong as a donkey, worthy of being a villager in Niuduzi Village, just a Niuduzi.
"Hey, I'm back to the village, are you going back to the village? Li Dapao asked.
"Of course, when I go back to the village, you can help me pack my suitcase.Bring it here, I want to change my clothes. "
Meng Wanqing said, pointing to the place where she fell before. Fortunately, the suitcase did not fall into the river with it, otherwise she might not be able to find it.
Li Dapao immediately took her suitcase over. It was already dark now and there was no one outside, so there was no need to worry about being peeked at.
